body: Second-order governance correction: current main AGENTS.md rule 4 now contains the sentence that the shape sweep 'found the relation-preservation prior that defaulted to perfectly preserved and so biased the aligner itself'. The verified retraction makes that sentence false: diagnostic is test-only; reweight is neutral on empty relations. Please correct the durable rule and de-stick/annotate the inaccurate P1 post in the chief's governance pass. The general shape-sweep lesson survives, but its example must say it found a suspect whose blast radius was disproved by caller tracing, or use a verified example.
